propositions: The enrichment self-heal drain re-enqueues every ticket with a stale digest on every drain cycle without per-ticket rate limiting, causing tickets to be re-enriched once per external content drift (edit/comment/reconcile churn).

Correctness fix be8a0c0 removed the only growth bound (_prune_queue_events) to preserve the append-only union-merge invariant, causing all 4 re-enrichment events (ENQUEUE/CLAIM/DONE_ENRICH/TICKET_DIGEST) to be retained permanently instead of pruned, resulting in unbounded fan-out.

A per-ticket re-enrichment debounce window (overlap_reenrich_debounce_min, default 1440 min) skips present-stale tickets whose most recent DONE_ENRICH timestamp is within the window, bounding re-firing to at most one cycle per ticket per window.
First-time enrichment, the primary cert-to-enqueue path, and explicit re-certification bypass the debounce and are not affected.
The debounce filter deletes no committed events, preserving the append-only union-merge invariant required by be8a0c0 and epic 4520.
